title: [MCP] Clear environment description after environment copy
summary: Environment descriptions are now cleared when an environment is copied, preventing the destination from retaining information about the source environment.
key_points: Subscribes to the database-level environment cleanup event triggered during environment copy
Clears the environment description BLOB for every environment-copy scenario
Adds a regression test to verify description is cleared after environment copy
Operates at database scope, consistent with the environment description's `DataPerCompany = false` setting
Existing descriptions remain unchanged unless the platform triggers an environment-copy cleanup event
quote: Clear the database-wide environment description when an environment is copied so the destination does not retain context describing the source environment.
